scenario: A time-dependent condition fires once per false-to-true edge (LTIM.2.5.1): a gate that closes ends the match, and reopening makes a new one that fires again, for one Ping that is never retracted. Drives the tick re-evaluation of a single-pattern `where` reading `dwell` (monotonic clock only). Pin: set 0; assert Ping; pump (dwell 0, shut); advance 2_s, pump (open, fires); advance 2_s, pump (4_s, shut); advance 2_s, pump (6_s, open again, fires). Messages are ['fired', 'fired']; a runtime that remembers the firing past the activation gives ['fired'].
rules_ds:
schema Ping scope logical:
    k: String key

rule gate:
    Ping p where (p.dwell >= 2_s and p.dwell < 4_s) or p.dwell >= 6_s
->
    log critical "fired"
